column1: # Scenarios over the seams of the process (ADR-0125 addendum (4) item 7): the properties of the core that the checklist
# of chapter 1.1 checks «by reading» (P/01.1-11, -15, -25, -26, -31) — tests of kit B through the adapter; the runner does
# not read this file. Columns and expectations — those of scenarios.tsv (README of the acceptance); the names are unique with it.
# Directives of the adapter (a step of its own, expect ok): @clock +N | -N — the clock of the core (Config.Now) shifts by N
# seconds from this step, cumulatively; at the first Open the clock is 2000000000; @reopen — Close() and Open(Config) on the
# same DataDir with the same clock (a restart; the stage durable); @parallel K — the next one step runs K times at once,
# its expect is «each <expect>» or «one <expect>; rest <expect>»: variables are bound only in «one», «rest» and «each» refer.
